name: Report on the desk
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a short practical note left on the commander's desk.
text: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The report is done. It is on your desk. Read it before you sign. — {name}

name: Eat something
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a note that nags the commander to look after themselves.
text: AUTHOR TO WRITE: You skipped the mess again. Eat something. I will check. — {name}

name: Tucked in the gear
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a note tucked into the commander's gear, for later.
text: AUTHOR TO WRITE: You will find this in the field. Come back in one piece. — {name}

name: Under the door, wanting
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a note pushed under the door after an unanswered knock, by someone who wanted company.
text: AUTHOR TO WRITE: I knocked. I know you were awake. I will not ask twice. Tonight. — {name}

name: Under the door
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a note pushed under the door after an unanswered knock.
text: AUTHOR TO WRITE: I came by. You did not open. It can wait until morning. — {name}
